title: Super Cup ATTP – Spring 2024: announcement
excerpt: Announcement of the ATTP SUPER CUP – Spring 2024 tournament
body_html:
From 24 to 26 May 2024, the TOP CUP Academy sports complex will once again host the SPRING-2024 national tournament of the SUPER CUP ATTP series for table tennis amateurs, in singles, with groups based on the ATTP ranking (senior category) and by age category (children, cadets, juniors).

We are confident that, like the previous tournaments, this one will be held at the highest level and will help promote sport and a healthy lifestyle, strengthening the importance and role of table tennis in the country’s sporting life.

Come and support our brave players! We will be grateful to everyone who decides to take part in this wonderful tournament and show their style of play and individual qualities, and we wish them every success, good luck and a winning spirit!
